image_qa.note: Both new editorial bodies are intentionally image-free. Their only image element is the existing Big Bud Man logo in shared site chrome; the navigation improvement adds no imagery, and no product, device, cultivar, or affiliate image is represented or linked.

search_console.decision: The report covered August 24 through September 20: 518 impressions, one click, 0.2% CTR, and average position 61.6. The only position 4-20 page rows had one to four impressions, so no data-led rewrite was justified; those tiny samples and the single Oklahoma query click were deliberately ignored. Old submitted-sitemap errors were checked against the current live sitemap, feed, and site index rather than treated as a new topic signal.

authority.action: Published an official-source complaint and adverse-event reporting worksheet that keeps emergency response, observations, inferences, product identity, lot evidence, jurisdiction, and case follow-up separate. Reciprocal links connect recall, label, certificate, licensed-shopping, vape, battery, and disposal resources. The Upstate New York Poison Center was logged as a qualified public-education and factual-review opportunity; no outreach was sent.
